text.div:
Discharge summary 2026-11-16

Admitted through the emergency department on 9 November 2026 after a fall while visiting his son in Copenhagen. X-ray showed a fracture of the neck of the femur.

His Swedish patient summary was received before surgery. Because of his penicillin allergy another antibiotic was given, his anticoagulant treatment was taken into account and bleeding prepared for, and the anaesthesia was adapted to his heart failure and emphysema.

Operated on 10 November 2026. The course after the operation was without complications.

Discharged on 16 November 2026 in a stable condition. His regular medication - insulin, blood-pressure medication and anticoagulant - continues. Recommended after discharge: rehabilitation of the hip and follow-up by his health centre in Sweden.

Status at discharge 2026-11-16

Discharged on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 in a stable condition, by ambulance to his home in Sweden and the home care of his municipality.

The wound is dry and healing; the sutures are to be removed 14 days after the operation. No fever.

Mobility: walks short distances indoors with a walking frame and the help of one person, transfers with the help of one person, cannot manage stairs. Full weight bearing allowed.

Daily activities: needs help with personal care and dressing; Barthel index 45, against 70 before the fall.

Breathing: oxygen saturation 93 percent breathing room air; short of breath on exertion, as before the fall.

Pain: controlled with paracetamol. Oriented, no confusion during the stay.
